snippet.title: Punch TV Trailer- Out NOW (App Store, Play Store)
snippet.description:
DOWNLOAD: App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/punch-tv/id6477147072
DOWNLOAD: Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.fourfats.punchTV

We will be focused on small and large scale updates going forward. Punch TV Round One is the first big update later this year. PVP 2.0 and some other stuff will come earlier.
------------------------------------------------------
PUNCH TV is the ultimate team fight show! You get to focus on the combat without the chaos.

STORY Ascend the tower of champions, sixty-five stages of varying challenges and game modes (FFA, 1 on 1, Tag Teams)

FIGHTERS of every shape and combat style, 55 playable! Fireballs, piledrivers, spinning kicks, backfists, suplexes, leg sweeps, rapids, beasts, robots, shotos and everything in between!

PVP online with your team of 3 fighters against players from around the world or against AI.  *ALL PVP Characters have balanced stats, there is no 'pay2win' for this mode.*

COOP in real time, fight together with up to 3 players online in a series of coop-only stage battle.

Online netcode offers both 'Rollback' (good for under 100ms) and 'Async' (preferable for over 100ms).

Supports bluetooth controllers, cloud saving.  Internet connection isn't required but you forfeit some features by not being online.

If you're considering supporting Four Fats, please consider the Starter or Premium upgrade and sharing the game with your buddies...and total strangers

At Four Fats, we aim to offer you an easy entry to the fighting game genre.  That's why our games are free to download - we do have in-app purchases for players that want them but they are not a requirement to enjoy the game as intended.

Current languages: English, Chinese, Portuguese, Japanese, Russian
Work in progress: Spanish

Translations are in collaboration with longtime players (below) it’s hard to add many languages with such few team members to handle it so that’s why we rely on players for help.
----------------
Music thanks ​⁠@MatthewPablo for the theme song, intermission and many others
Translation thanks to Gax, Luke, Raseman, Placeholder & Frank for Chinese, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish & Japanese
Thanks to those that helped test so far and in the future
Thanks to ​⁠@AndrewHelbig for taking up the role as the Host
Thanks to IUN for various fx
